releaseNotes: Add: MDL1 serial query -- a connected device now reports its own catalog model ID (e.g. "esp32-7in") so Companion can detect a stale saved model selection (e.g. a port previously used by a different physical board) before offering to reflash it, and warn/require re-confirmation instead of silently flashing the wrong firmware.

Add: M5Stack Tab5 (ESP32-P4, 1280x720 MIPI-DSI) support -- new catalog model "m5stack-tab5". Built and compile-verified without access to real hardware; treat as an unverified first build, not confirmed-working like every other model here. See esp32lcd/board_configs/m5stack-tab5's file header for what's confirmed vs. still a best-effort guess (particularly display rotation and which of three possible panel/touch hardware variants this specific unit has -- the firmware auto-detects between them at boot, matching M5Stack's own driver logic, but that detection itself hasn't been exercised on a real board yet).
